title: Global Forum Rallies Support for Tibet: Uniting Against Authoritarianism
description: National Chengchi University in Taiwan hosted a symposium to address the impact of US legislation on Tibet, China's authoritarianism, and the global political landscape. Key figures emphasized the importance of unity and international cooperation in defending Tibet's cultural and political identity against China's repressive actions.

title: G7 Calls Out China's Trade Practices
description: The G7 foreign ministers have voiced concerns over China's trade practices, citing harmful overcapacity and market distortions. In their draft statement, they urged China to avoid export control measures, especially on essential minerals, to prevent supply chain disruptions, while emphasizing stability in the Taiwan Strait.

title: U.S. Navy aircraft shadowed by Chinese warplanes as it flies over Taiwan Strait
description: China sent military planes to track a U.S. anti-submarine Navy aircraft as it transited the Taiwan Strait, Beijing says, as tension mounts between the superpowers.

title: China deploys warplanes to monitor US military flight over Taiwan Strait
description: China considers Taiwan to be part of its territory and claims jurisdiction over the body of water separating the two.

title: Amid tensions with China, US Navy aircraft flies through contested Taiwan Strait
description: China’s military criticised a US Navy plane flying over the Taiwan Strait, saying the US was misleading the world and misrepresenting the law

title: China Scrambles Jets Against US Military Plane
description: China has scrambled jets to track a U.S. military plane transiting the sensitive Taiwan Strait on Tuesday.

title: Chinese warplanes track US Navy aircraft through the sensitive Taiwan Strait

title: Taiwan Celebrates Baseball Triumph Amid Political Tensions
description: Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te praised the national baseball team for their international victory in Japan. Competing as 'Chinese Taipei,' the team's success has bolstered national pride. The win spurred a public celebration, underscoring tensions with China over Taiwan's global recognition.

title: Tensions Soar as U.S. Patrol Aircraft Flies Through Taiwan Strait
description: China deployed naval and air forces to monitor a U.S. Navy aircraft in the Taiwan Strait, accusing the U.S. of misleading the international community. The U.S. states its actions are legal, upholding navigational rights. China and the U.S. have long-standing disagreements over the strait's sovereignty.

title: Navigational Tensions: US Navy Flight Provokes Chinese Response
description: A U.S. Navy patrol aircraft's flight through the Taiwan Strait incited criticism from China's military, which deployed naval and air forces in response. The U.S. insists the flight complied with international law, highlighting ongoing tensions over the strait, which China claims jurisdiction over.
